spans.text: ...Late at night, in the Commander's office.
After sending ST AR-15 and Dandelion away with great difficulty, the Commander makes a call.
Persica, what do you make of the video that RO sent you earlier today?
Right, right, right, just a little to the left. No, a bit further up. Yes, that's it, that's it.
Wait a minute, don't put my bookshelf down like—
Crash—
(Sighs) Moving is such a pain.
Ahhh, forget it, you guys just pack up for now.
Commander, with all the Dolls at the base, have you considered opening a home mover's division? All the moving companies on the market are so unreliable...
Are you STILL moving in?
Yeah, the space I was assigned at your base was too small for me. Plus, there's all this equipment in my room that's old enough to be my grandfather.
But we bought those just two years ago...
Also, my coffee machine broke. How am I supposed to work like that?
The Café is just below you, you know. While the staff is probably resting, you can still use the coffee vending machine.
Huh? I didn't know you guys provided such services...
Persica vanishes from the transmission window.
A while later, she returns with a cup of coffee, looking very satisfied.
I live again.
Right, now I can start working.
Persica starts dumping cubes of sugar into the coffee cup.
I watched the video you had RO send me earlier.
I want to hear your thoughts.
I can't be 100% sure, but I did try to cross-reference it with news records in Berlin over the years and nothing like it has happened before.
Which means?
At first, I thought it might be some kind of commercial movie or something, but considering the image quality...
I don't think anyone with that kind of money would be bored enough to make such a film.
We did some analysis on our own, and no matter how you look at it, it doesn't look forged.
Dandelion concluded that Machlian's virtual consciousness is so fragile it can't withstand the strain of a memory fragment transfer.
So we can only assume that the images are real, they just haven't happened yet.
So that terrifying apocalypse will actually come to pass...
Well, you might have a chance to stop it, Commander.
Also, I'm quite intrigued by the blank region that 15 said suddenly appeared in Machlian's virtual consciousness.
Unfortunately, all the data she recorded was useless, and I can't study it further...
Care to speculate about it?
I do have some ideas about what might be going on...
But since this sort of thing has only happened once before, I'm not sure how useful my theories may be.
Compared to the first two hacking attempts, 15 and Dandelion did it while Machlian was asleep.
Simply put, it's like how human beings have the lowest control over their conscious minds when they're asleep.

Considering that Machlian is a new model of Paradeus Nyto, and that her virtual cognition image is similar to that of a human's subconscious, my guess is that her defensive mechanisms are lowered when she's sound asleep, to an extent.
Hacking her during this time does have a possibility of revealing what is normally hidden.
You mean Machlian is deliberately concealing these memories of Morridow's?
I have several theories. This is just one of them.
What are the others?
Do you understand the concept of telepathic connection among Isomers?
Early on in Tallinn, I realized that these Isomers possessed the ability to share senses without the use of communication devices.

While this sort of phenomenon doesn't allow for the stable transfer of large quantities of high-definition information, it's more than enough to allow portions of their memories to be transmitted to similar entities who can receive this sensory induction.
So basically, Machlian could simply have received a transmission containing fragments of Morridow's memories?
Yes. But the fact that she can receive those images already proves that Machlian is the same kind of Paradeus unit as Morridow.
I also have another hypothesis, though it may sound a little far-fetched.
Go on.
Although Machlian's body has been modified, she is still within the parameters of a human being.
Information is transmitted within the human body in two ways—through chemical reactions and potential differences.
Both methods involve the generation of various chemical elements or electrical charges within a cell.
When a human stands next to someone with completely identical genes, he or she can be very sensitive to signals sent through transmission methods that are very similar to their own.
Hm? In other words...
In layman's terms, you could say that they have a telepathic connection in the way identical human twins share a bond.
...You mean Machlian might be Morridow's twin sister?
And the presence of Morridow's memories in her virtual consciousness could be due to influences from Morridow's electromagnetic field?
Of course, that's just a hypothesis.
In order to verify it, I would need samples of Machlian's and Morridow's DNA for comparison.
But if this hypothesis is valid, it means Morridow might be able to see you through Machlian's eyes, so you'd better be careful, Commander.
The Commander takes a sip of cold tea and grimaces at the bitterness.
What's wrong? You can't even find someone to make you coffee without Kalina by your side?
Ahem, that'll change when I return.
But Kalina won't be able to make coffee for you for a while, no?
You'll be lucky if she can even talk to you when you get back.
What do you mean?
You didn't know?
Kalina was transferred to a city general hospital today because her condition got worse. Apparently they found minor silicification on her skin.
Thud. The tablet slips out of the Commander's hand and crashes to the floor.
Persica still seems to be saying something, but the Commander can no longer hear her.
The world is dead silent. The Commander's promise echoes in their own ears.
"Tell her to wait for me. I'll be back."
